basic_info.description: Set on a picturesque tree-lined street, this charming 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo in a boutique elevator building is filled with natural light and features hardwood floors, high ceilings, and a spacious living room with a fireplace. The residence is currently tenant-occupied at $5,800/month with a lease through July 24, 2026. The expansive great room flows seamlessly into a remodeled kitchen and opens to a charming private deckideal for morning coffee or evening unwinding. The primary suite offers a walk-in closet and an en-suite bathroom with a shower, while the second updated bathroom features a shower-over-tub. Additional highlights include 1-car independent garage parking, in-home laundry, elevator access from the garage, dedicated storage closet on the garden level, abundant finished and unfinished bonus spaces with tall ceilings (including a shared media room with full bathroom on garden level), and a charming shared rear garden. With a 96-Walk Score near top-rated restaurants, retail, coffee shops, Golden Gate Park, UCSF & CPMC, this is a rare opportunity to own a turnkey condo building in one of SF's best neighborhoods. (For privacy, photos are of the upstairs residence, also for sale, which shares a very similar floor plan to 2040 Ellis!).
